title: Ashpit
description: An &3Ashpit&r can be installed beneath a &3Firebox/Heating Oven&r or &3Smokestack&r which will collect &6Ash&r, that can be used as a cheap black dye alternative aswell as in the creation of &6Industrial Fertilizer&r.
&6Coal Ash&r can later be centrifuged to obtain some &6Boron&r.
An Ashpit below an &3Industrial Smokestack&r will produce &6Fine Soot,&r used in the creation of &6Fullerite&r, a late game material.
